definitions.full: H7185. qashah I. [ קָשָׁה ] verb be hard, severe, fierce (Late Hebrew קָשָׁה be severe ; Arabic () be hard, dry , III. endure, struggle against, severity ; Aramaic קְשָׁא , be hard, difficult ; Jewish-Aramaic קַשְׁיָה קְשִׁי, adjective hard ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular קָֽשְׁתָה 1Sam 5:7 , קָשָׁ֑תָה Gen 49:7 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִקְשֶׁה Deut 1:17 ; 15:18 , וַיִּ֫קֶשׁ 2 Samuel 19:44; — 1 be hard, difficult Deut 1:17 (of a legal case; מִן comparative). 2 be hard, severe , עָלֵינוּ ׳ק יָדוֺ 1Sam 5:7 (of ׳י , in judgement); ׳יִק בְעֵינֶ֑ךָ . Deut 15:18 it shall not be hard in thine eyes (seem a severe trial, an injustice); of wrath Gen 49:7 (poem in J; || עָ֑ז ); of fierce words 2 Samuel 19:44. Niph`al Participle נִקְשֶׁה Isa 8:21 hardly bestead, hard pressed. Pi`el Imperfect 3feminine singular בְּלִדְתָּהּ וַתְּקַשׁ Gen 35:16 (E) she made hard in her bearing (had severe labour). Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular הִקְשָׁה Exod 13:15 +, etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיֶּקֶשׁ 2Chr 36:13 ; 3 masculine plural וַיַּקְשׁוּ Jer 7:26 +, etc.; Infinitive construct suffix בְּהַקְשֹׁתָהּ Gen 35:17 ; Participle מַקְשֶׁה Prov 28:14 ; 29:1 ; — 1 make difficult, difficulty: לְשַׁלְּחֵנוּ הִקְשָׁה Exod 13:15 Pharaoh made difficulty about sending us away ; of travail Gen 35:17 (E; as Pi`el ); לִשְׁאוֺל הִקְשִׁיתָ 2Kin 2:10 thou hast made hard to ask , asked a hard thing. 2 make severe, burdensome , yoke imposed by king 1Kin 12:4 2Chr 10:4 . 3. a. make hard, stiff, stubborn , figurative of obstinacy: אֶתעָֿרְמָּם וַיַּקְשׁוּ 2Kin 17:14 they stiffened their neck , so Jer 7:26 ; 17:23 ; 19:15 ; Deut 10:16 ; 2Chr 30:8 ; 36:13 ; Neh 9:16-17 , 29 ; Prov 29:1 ; לְבַבְכֶם אַלתַּֿקְשׁוּ Psa 95:8 , compare Prov 28:14 ; subject פ אֶתלֵֿב ׳אַקְשֶׁה ׳י, Exod 7:3 (P), accusative אֶתרֿוחוֺ Deut 2:30 , b. shew stubborness Job 9:4 (with אֶל person [ ׳י ]).
